def load_input(filepath: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:

def compute_salary(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    gross = data["Gross Salary"]
    gross_salary = sum(gross.values())
    
    # HRA exemption u/s 10(13A)
    basic_da = gross["Basic Salary"] + gross["Dearness Allowance"]
    hra_received = gross["HRA"]
    rent_paid = data["Actual Rent Paid"]
    metro = data["City"] == "metro"
    hra_exempt = min(
        hra_received,
        0.5 * basic_da if metro else 0.4 * basic_da,
        rent_paid - 0.1 * basic_da
    )
    hra_exempt = max(0, int(hra_exempt))
    
    # LTA exemption u/s 10(5)
    lta_received = gross["LTA"]
    lta_claimed = data["LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"]
    lta_exempt = min(lta_received, lta_claimed)
    
    # Deductions u/s 16
    std_deduction = 50000  # 16(ia)
    entertainment_allowance = gross["Entertainment Allowance"]
    # For government employees: min(entertainment allowance, 5000, 20% of basic)
    ent_deduction = min(entertainment_allowance, 5000, 0.2 * gross["Basic Salary"])
    ent_deduction = int(ent_deduction)
    prof_tax = data["Professional Tax"]  # 16(iii)
    
    net_salary = gross_salary - hra_exempt - lta_exempt - std_deduction - ent_deduction - prof_tax
    
    return {
        "Gross Salary": gross_salary,
        "Exemptions": {
            "Section 10(13A)": hra_exempt,

        },

    total_80c = ppf + elss + nsc + ssy + scss + epf_emp + epf_vol + pension_80ccc
    ded_80c = min(total_80c, 150000)

            tax += (income - 1000000) * 0.3
            income = 1000000

            tax += (income - 500000) * 0.2
            income = 500000
        if income > 250000:

            surcharge = tax_after_rebate * 0.10

            surcharge = tax_after_rebate * 0.15
        elif total_taxable <= 50000000:
            surcharge = tax_after_rebate * 0.25

            surcharge = tax_after_rebate * 0.37

    tax_after_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge

    total_taxable = gross_total - total_ded
    
    # Normal income (excluding special rate incomes)
    special_incomes = stcg_111a + stcg_other + ltcg_112a + ltcg_non_equity + ltcg_other
    normal_income = total_taxable - special_incomes

    def slab_tax(income):
        tax = 0
        if income > 1000000:
            tax += (income - 1000000) * 0.3
            income = 1000000
        if income > 500000:
            tax += (income - 500000) * 0.2
